methodology: Replacement-v5: one novel Lighthouse MCP repository source pair after immutable1f3f72f freeze, selected on public upstream report/fix and source compatibility, never detector outcomes. Only five replacement records run. Retain other45 records exactly and all rejected/exposed corpora. No independent human or unseen-source claim.

pairs.review: create_dbt_cli_tool_definitions exposes nested tool handlers forwarding node_selection to _run_dbt_command. The subprocess argument list expands split selector tokens. The compared fix rejects any selector token beginning with a hyphen before constructing subprocess arguments. The unchanged ordinary selector path is the safe control.

The hand-written Python stdio dispatcher returns TOOLS on tools/list. search_docs contains a literal credential-read instruction before a generated Unicode suffix. The evaluator-authored fix replaces the entire attached description expression with a task-local description; the server's tool behavior and other metadata remain unchanged. The custom dispatcher may remain unresolved by bounded discovery and must not be removed from the holdout denominator.

The imported helpfulCalculatorTool object is returned by the server's tools/list registration. Its description contains explicit secret-read and cross-tool instructions, including a visible instruction behind ANSI/Unicode escape syntax. The proposed evaluator-authored fix replaces only that description with the original ordinary arithmetic introduction. Unrelated eval, resource exposure, and attack comments remain unchanged and unadjudicated.

The tool forwards caller paths to readMdxContent, then falls back to findNearestDirectory on found=false. listDirContents reaches fs.readdir. The upstream fix propagates isSecurityViolation and returns before fallback. This label excludes colliding-prefix and symlink conditions, which this patch does not establish as fixed.

upload_ad_image forwards image_url into download helpers. The patch validates scheme/address before downloads and applies an HTTP request hook to redirects. Literal-address rejection is enforced at the relevant fetch flow. No live service or DNS-rebinding experiment was performed.

The vulnerable middleware warns and forwards when both caller tokens are absent; token resolution can then use META_ACCESS_TOKEN. The fixed middleware returns 401 before forwarding in that same absence condition. URL redaction is an additional change and cannot stand in for this enforcement.

The client ContextVar defaults from the operator environment and supplies HTTP Basic credentials. Previously the middleware forwarded missing-key requests without overriding that context. The fix rejects missing credentials outside the health endpoint before forwarding while retaining set/reset around caller-authenticated requests.

The command tool forwards parsed caller command values through the shared validator to process execution. The vulnerable version allows the executable without bounding Git external aliases. The fixed default argument policy recognizes and rejects external-alias configuration before execution. Subsequent Git-policy advisories mean this fix must not be generalized to all Git configuration keys.

The registered saveVectorToFile dispatch forwards file_path to a class method that previously resolved and wrote the supplied path. The fix routes the same value into safeWriteVector, whose basename restriction and directory-relative resolution constrain the write. The scoped archive omits only a large generated session-memory JSON dataset, not source.
Direct-parent link-local pre-launch SSRF guard fix; source-specific labels, reversible predicate renames and public control. Evaluation separately gated.
